subskill: Lowest running balance during a list of decimal deposits and withdrawals
grade_rationale: Mid for grade 5 (5.NBT.B.7): five decimal additions and subtractions to hundredths, kept in order as a running balance, then a comparison of the balances.
prompt: On Monday morning, Jun had $46.33 in a savings account. During the week Jun made these changes, in this order: took out $8.80, put in $9.60, took out $13.80, put in $11.20, and took out $7.40. What was the least amount of money, in dollars, that was in the account at any time during the week?
explanation: Keep a running balance: 37.53, 47.13, 33.33, 44.53, 37.13 (and 46.33 at the start). The least of these is 33.33, right after the third change. The final balance, 37.13, is not the least.
solve: const FM=v=>{for(const p of [0,1,2,3]){const m=Math.round(v*10**p);if(Math.abs(m/10**p-v)<1e-9)return String(+(m/10**p).toFixed(p))}for(let d=2;d<=200;d++){const n=Math.round(v*d);if(Math.abs(n/d-v)<1e-9){const g=(a,b)=>b?g(b,a%b):a;const k=g(Math.abs(n),d),a=n/k,b=d/k,w=Math.trunc(Math.abs(a)/b),r=Math.abs(a)%b,s=a<0?'-':'';return w?s+w+' '+r+'/'+b:s+r+'/'+b}}return String(v)};const t=[-8.8,9.6,-13.8,11.2,-7.4];let b=46.33,m=b;for(const x of t){b+=x;m=Math.min(m,b)}return FM(Math.round(m*100)/100);
